name: Divine Reckoning
detailed_description:
Divine Reckoning is a third-person horror shooting console game adapted from Dante's Divine Comedy: Inferno. The players will enter the hell mentioned in The Divine Comedy: Inferno and continuously explore and adventure, encountering various fantastic monsters. Only when the players face Satan directly can they return to the human world. The game features multi-stage transforming, capturing, and jump-scare horror monsters, as well as various attack mechanisms for bosses that combine with the terrain and other monster attacks. The vast and expansive hellish landscapes, along with terrifying and bizarre bosses designed with mythological elements, will provide players with a unique visual shock experience that is hard to forget.

"In a world decided by AI, those AI deemed obsolete were finally granted a chance to reshape themselves. However, will they remain their true selves after the reshaping procedure?"

As your life collapsed, you were forcibly transported to this brutal hell.

You wake up in a mysterious and luxurious cabin, where a female demon named Lamia guides you into Hell.

The colossal form of the Principalities looms over Limbo, and the bloodthirsty Cerberus, the three-headed hound, blocks your path.

Minos, entwined with poisonous pincers, judges sins, and the wailing agony of the sinners scorches Hell with their blood and tears.

Of course, on your journey, you also encounter people of various kinds. Some are friendly yet greedy, others are indifferent and stubborn.

Some live in high-rise buildings, while others lie in the mud and ditches.

You must leap into the endless abyss again and again.

Let Lamia guide you, step by step, deeper into the depths of Hell.

There, time and gravity are distorted.

Inescapable chains eternally bind the most extreme evil of the world.

This evil Satan speaks the sweetest and most enticing words. He eagerly awaits you, just like those who have warmly helped you along the way.

The way they look at you, with eagerness and greed, is like staring at a rare prey.

This is the second chance offered to you by the commanding AI. This is the opportunity...that you must seize.

Traverse this desperate hell and survive, and then you may leave and go back to the human world.

Do you see those raving monsters?

They are all failures. Those whose first lives were deemed failures, and whose second chances were lost.

Do not become them. Do not become them. Do not become them.

But...Who will you choose to become?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win10
  • Processor: intel Core i5_6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

  • OS: win10

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
